sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned Public Prosecutor.
Perused the material available on record.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submitted that the petitioner has been falsely implicated in the present case.
Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner and prosecutrix were in a consensual relationship.
To substantiate aforesaid contention, learned counsel drew attention of the Court towards various photographs of prosecutrix and petitioner available on record.

Learned counsel further submitted that the prosecutrix voluntarily eloped with the present petitioner on his motorcycle on [2023/RJJD/015957] (2 of 3) [CRLMB-3113/2023] 04.01.2023 and thereafter went to Ahmedabad using public transportation.

Learned counsel submitted that after staying in Ahmedabad for 6-7 days, petitioner and prosecutrix further travelled to one Pathdi Ganv which is about 200 Kms. from Ahmedabad using public transportation and worked there as a daily labourers earning their livelihood.

Learned counsel submitted that in view of aforesaid, prosecutrix had ample opportunities to disclose the fact of she being abducted or subjected to forcible sexual assault by the Vimal vs State Of Rajasthan (2023/Rjjd/015957) on 18 May, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/148740794/
1 present petitioner to the co-labourers or to co-passengers plying in the public transportation used by them. Learned counsel submitted that the petitioner is a young boy of 26 years who is languishing in Jail since 31.01.2023; challan has already been filed and the trial of the case may take long time to conclude, therefore, the petitioner may be enlarged on bail.
Per contra, learned Public Prosecutor opposed the bail application.

Having regard to the facts and circumstances of the case, without expressing any opinion on the merits/demerits of the case, this Court is of the opinion that the bail application filed by the petitioner deserves to be accepted.
Consequently, the bail application filed under Section 439 Cr.P.C. is allowed.

It is ordered that petitioner-Vimal S/o Ganesh, arrested in connection with FIR No.07/2023 Police Station Rajtalab,
District Banswara, shall be released on bail; provided he executes a personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- and two sureties of Rs.25,000/- each to the satisfaction of the learned trial Court.

Petitioner shall be required to appear before [2023/RJJD/015957] (3 of 3) [CRLMB-3113/2023]
that Court on all dates of hearing and as and when called upon to do so.
